assertions.description: The detection surface for WGSL language features, navigator.gpu.wgslLanguageFeatures, is exposed (prerequisite: buffer_view is a WGSL language feature, not a GPUFeatureName).
createShaderModule accepts a module whose only use of the feature is the `requires buffer_view;` directive, with zero compilation errors.
assertions.test: (async()=>{try{const d=await (globalThis.__bufferViewConfDevice??=(async()=>{const a=await navigator.gpu.requestAdapter();if(!a)throw new Error('no adapter');return a.requestDevice()})());d.pushErrorScope('validation');const m=d.createShaderModule({code:"requires buffer_view;\n@compute @workgroup_size(1) fn main() {}"});const i=await m.getCompilationInfo();d.popErrorScope().catch(()=>{});return i.messages.every(x=>x.type!=='error')}catch(e){return false}})()

assertions.description: A storage variable of the opaque type buffer<16> can be reinterpreted through bufferView<vec4f> and bufferView<vec4u> and the module compiles with zero errors.
bufferArrayView<array<f32>> and bufferArrayView<array<u32>> carve runtime-sized views out of one unsized buffer variable, arrayLength works on the results, and the module compiles with zero errors.
bufferLength accepts pointers to both sized (buffer<32>) and unsized (buffer) variables and the module compiles with zero errors.

Assigning one buffer-typed variable to another must produce a compilation error on every browser: where buffer_view is supported the opaque type is not constructible or assignable; elsewhere the requires directive fails first.
bufferView<vec4f> at const offset 0 over buffer<8> (MinTypeSize 16 > N 8) must produce a compilation error on every browser: a shader-creation error where supported, the requires failure elsewhere.
